payload.title: File:Mahajangasuchus skeletal.png
payload.description_html: skeletal reconstruction of the holotype in lateral and dorsal view, with reconstructed skull from other specimens, and other un-preserved bones based in relatives. Only two osteoderms are figured, which confirm the presence of at least 2 paramedian rows on the back. The lateral view is showcased with sagittal limbs for clarity purposes
